lines.en: I give Kaori a call and find out that she's working at the diner per usual this morning.
lines.zh: 我给 Kaori 打电话，得知她今早照常在餐馆上班。

lines.en: She tells me about how slow it is and I take that as a hint to go over there and help her kill time, but I'm met with surprise upon actually showing up.
lines.zh: 她跟我说生意有多冷清，我把这当成暗示，过去帮她消磨时间，但真到了那儿却让我意外。

lines.en: Apparently, not only does Kaori have a hard time comprehending human language, she has a hard time understanding the insinuations that come with it...
lines.zh: 显然，Kaori 不仅很难理解人类语言，也很难听懂话里那些暗示……

lines.en: But regardless, she's able to clock out for her break early and spends the next half hour asking me random questions about my favorite 'human foods' other than hamburgers.
lines.zh: 但不管怎样，她还是提前打了卡休息，接下来半小时一直在问我各种奇怪的问题，比如除了汉堡以外我最喜欢的「人类食物」是什么。

lines.en: I decide to cut the conversation about food short when I notice Kaori produce a notebook from her bag and begin to write things down.
lines.zh: 当我看见 Kaori 从包里掏出笔记本开始记录时，我决定赶紧结束这个话题。

lines.en: I'm not exactly sure what notes she feels compelled to take right now, but I'm almost positive that knowing my favorite foods won't help her in any way, shape, or form.
lines.zh: 我不确定她现在为什么非要记笔记，但我几乎可以肯定，知道我喜欢的食物对她没有任何帮助。

lines.en: Unfortunately for both of us, the half hour we have together goes by extremely quickly, and Kaori eventually has to start working again.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，我们这半小时过得太快，Kaori 最后还是得回去上班。

lines.en: I try to make plans with her to hang out for a little longer next time, but I don't think she understands as she just blushes and runs into the back room...
lines.zh: 我试着跟她约下次多待一会儿，但我不知道她有没有听懂，因为她只是脸一红就冲进后厨了……
